final: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS account_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), scored AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, account_avg, account_avg / AVG(account_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio FROM per_account) SELECT account_id, frequency, account_avg, ratio FROM scored ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
